svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 05 · Los Angeles · 09/12 Sunset Boulevard (Common)
svg.desc: It bends along the north edge of campus. After dark the headlights trace every curve. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
